  here::here(

```{r}

df_books_read <- books_raw |>
  filter(exclusive_shelf == "read") |>
  mutate(
    year_read = year(date_read)
  )

```


```{r}

get_googlebooks_genre <- function(title, author) {
  # Construct URL
  url <- paste0(
    "https://www.googleapis.com/books/v1/volumes?q=intitle:",
    URLencode(title, reserved = TRUE),
    "+inauthor:",
    URLencode(author, reserved = TRUE)
  )
  
  res <- httr::GET(url)
  if (httr::status_code(res) != 200) return(NA)
  
  # Prevent simplification
  data <- jsonlite::fromJSON(httr::content(res, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"), simplifyVector = FALSE)
  
  if (is.null(data$items) || length(data$items) == 0) return(NA)
  
  # Find first item with categories
  for (item in data$items) {
    if (is.list(item) && !is.null(item$volumeInfo$categories)) {
      return(paste(head(item$volumeInfo$categories, 3), collapse = ", "))
    }
  }
  
  return(NA)
}




get_googlebooks_genre("Pride and Prejudice", "Jane Austen")

```



```{r}

get_googlebooks_genre_safe <- function(title, author) {
  url <- paste0(
    "https://www.googleapis.com/books/v1/volumes?q=intitle:",
    URLencode(title, reserved = TRUE),
    "+inauthor:",
    URLencode(author, reserved = TRUE)
  )
  
  res <- GET(url)
  if (status_code(res) != 200) return(NA)
  
  data <- fromJSON(content(res, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"), simplifyVector = FALSE)
  
  if (is.null(data$items) || length(data$items) == 0) return(NA)
  
  for (item in data$items) {
    if (is.list(item) && !is.null(item$volumeInfo$categories)) {
      return(paste(head(item$volumeInfo$categories, 3), collapse = ", "))
    }
  }
  return(NA)
}

# Apply to your dataframe
df_books_read$Genre <- NA  # initialize

pb <- progress_bar$new(total = nrow(df_books_read))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(df_books_read))) {
  df_books_read$Genre[i] <- get_googlebooks_genre_safe(df_books_read$title[i], df_books_read$author[i])
  pb$tick()
  Sys.sleep(0.5)  # avoid hammering API
}


```
